title: Jelly Roll's singing and Carew hearing Tony and Jelly Roll in New Orleans' district
summary: Carew compares Jelly Roll's singing to Tony Jackson, recalls strolling the district and hearing Tony and Jelly Roll play, and the Spanish tinge in Crave and New Orleans Blues.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
